lines.t: Throne made of thunder, galaxies fade when He step through the veil so cold
Eyes like fire, robe dipped red, every crown on the floor made gold
Whole sky crack when He pull up, wheels in the wheels, pure flame when He roll
Voice hit once, shake bones in the grave, drag kings out they fake thrones cold
Charts, wars, money and clout, all that talk look small from His height
One breath crush whole bloodline flex, one glance put a billion in fright
Name on His thigh like ink made of lightning, banner of a kingdom no end
Scepter in His hand, just tilt of His wrist make the proud man break, unbend
He the Mountain that fall on Babel, He the Flood that erase man’s schemes
Boss of all bosses, King of all realms, write “vain” on the world’s blueprints
Bow that neck, opp, when the Great One ride, every tongue gotta say “Most High”
No cap there, just crowns on the floor, whole squad robed white when He slide by
If you ever yelled “smoke,” this the smoke you fear, holy fire in the Judge’s eyes
YAHUWAH rule, YahuShua lead, all knees to the ground when He split that sky
He don’t need steel, just Word from His lips, sharp blade make the whole front fold
Scrolls fly open, ink turn live, all receipts that He kept unfold
Every secret hit center screen, every thought on replay slow
No plea deal, no last-minute spin, just truth like a hammer on stone
He stomp on the beast, break horns and crowns, make the dragon taste ash, not air
Turn terror to dust, make warlords whimper, strip em all of they war-god stare
He the Kingdom, Power, Glory in flesh, final echo of every Psalm
Storm in His step, but His voice to His own feel soft like a healing balm
Bow that neck, opp, when the Great One ride, every tongue gotta say “Most High”
No cap there, just crowns on the floor, whole squad robed white when He slide by
If you ever yelled “smoke,” this the smoke you fear, holy fire in the Judge’s eyes
YAHUWAH rule, YahuShua lead, all knees to the ground when He split that sky[OUTRO – SONG DESCRIPTION]
